household.name: Marisol
household.job: Registered nurse at a hospital in Koreatown, works three 12-hour shifts per week, usually Tuesday, Wednesday and Saturday 07:00-19:30, but swaps shifts fairly often and picks up an occasional overtime night shift
household.routine: On shift days she wakes at 05:15, makes coffee, and leaves by 06:20 to beat traffic. Gets home around 20:15, eats leftovers standing up, showers, and is asleep by 22:00. On off days she sleeps in until 08:30, does a Pilates class or goes for a walk in the neighborhood, runs errands, and batch-cooks on Sunday afternoons.
household.habits: Tidy about her own dishes but leaves her laundry in the dryer for days. Keeps the thermostat low at night. Quiet in the evenings after shifts. Labels her food in the fridge. Often forgets to update the app after a shift swap, so her listed blocks are only partly accurate.
household.social: Close with a few nursing friends and has dinner with them about once a week, usually on an off day. Video-calls her mom in San Diego on Sundays. Rarely hosts people at the house, but her boyfriend visits on some Thursday and Friday evenings and occasionally stays over.

household.name: Dev
household.job: Freelance video editor and occasional gaffer on commercial shoots; mostly works from home on a spare-room desk, but shoot days are irregular and can run 10-14 hours with calls as early as 05:00 or wrapping after midnight
household.routine: No fixed schedule. On edit days he starts around 10:00, works in long stretches with headphones on, takes a late lunch, and often keeps working until 23:00 or later. On shoot days he is gone before dawn or all day and comes back exhausted. Goes to a climbing gym in the evenings when he has time, usually two or three times a week but never the same days.
household.habits: Night owl who runs the kitchen late, making noodles or tea around midnight. Leaves gear cases in the hallway and mugs by his desk. Keeps a loud mechanical keyboard but uses headphones. Never uses the app for his shoot days because they change too quickly, and his one block is an old gym habit that no longer matches his week.
household.social: Wide, loose friend circle from the film industry; goes out for drinks after wraps and sometimes brings two or three friends over to watch movies on a weekend night with little notice. Dating casually. Texts the roommate about guests only sometimes.
